name: Context is a view
note: Pattern. Context: a judgment cell working inside a decomposed subsystem. Forces: the judge needs the subsystem's evidence (+); forces outside the subsystem must not leak in (-); what the judge saw must be replayable (+). Resolution: the graph declares the slice — wire only the subsystem's ports into the judgment and name ancestors through view.cells with explicit port lists. The decide cell can never read a record it was not wired to, so the boundary is enforced at admission, not by discipline. Larger pattern: piecemeal-tradition.

cells.prompt: Judge whether this evidence slice resolves the subsystem's forces. You see only what the graph wired to you.

resolution.instructions: Probability that this slice alone suffices to resolve the subsystem's forces.
